# Manifest

> Manifest (https://manifeststartup.com) is an AI-powered workspace that turns a founder's raw startup idea into structured, investor-ready documents: a business model canvas, a pitch deck, a product requirements document and a provisional patent draft. Manifest is in development; the public site is a demo preview and is not yet operational for real business decisions.

## When to use Manifest

- A user wants to turn a startup or product idea into a business model canvas, pitch deck, PRD or provisional patent draft.
- A user with a Manifest account wants an agent to create, list, update or delete their ideas, or generate documents for them, through the REST API (API key required).
- Do not use Manifest for legal, tax, financial or investment advice; its documents are AI drafts for the founder to review.

Full guidance for agents: [Agent guide](https://manifeststartup.com/agents.md)

## API

- [API reference](https://manifeststartup.com/docs/api.md): authentication (`Authorization: Bearer manifest_sk_...`), endpoints, errors and limits
- [Authentication guide](https://manifeststartup.com/auth.md): API-key setup, scopes, and safe handling
- [OpenAPI specification](https://manifeststartup.com/openapi.json): machine-readable description of `/api/v1`
- [Manifest MCP server](https://manifeststartup.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP tools for authenticated idea and document operations; use your Manifest API key as a Bearer token
- [MCP server card](https://manifeststartup.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Manifest documentation MCP server](https://manifeststartup.com/docs/mcp): read-only tools for API, pricing, and product documentation
- [Documentation MCP server card](https://manifeststartup.com/.well-known/mcp/docs-server-card.json)
- [API catalog](https://manifeststartup.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [API pricing](https://manifeststartup.com/pricing)
- [Pricing and API limits](https://manifeststartup.com/pricing.md)
- [AR discovery catalog](https://manifeststartup.com/.well-known/ard.json)
